label: Celery tasks and beat schedule
instruction: Generate modules/complaint_cms/tasks.py and modules/complaint_cms/schedule.py, max 50 lines total. tasks.py defines Celery @shared_task wrappers cms_process_sla and cms_auto_close_resolved calling process_complaint_sla and auto_close_resolved_complaints from modules.complaint_cms.services.events. schedule.py imports crontab from celery.schedules and exports BEAT_SCHEDULE (running cms_process_sla every 15 minutes and cms_auto_close_resolved daily at midnight) and TASK_ROUTES mapping "modules.complaint_cms.tasks.*" to {"queue": "default"}. Return valid JSON response.
